title: Optional settlement receipt on a marketplace service or order
description: Rail-neutral. Existing rails (card, Stripe payout) keep their own reference and may omit verify. For rail nano:mainnet every field below can be re-checked by a stranger from a public node.

ref.description: nano:mainnet: the 64-hex send block hash. stripe: the payout or charge id.

verify.description: A command or URL a stranger can run. Optional.
